documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Basic
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: The bundle is one roll each of PLA Basic Black (10101) and PLA Basic Jade White (10100) plus one LED Lamp Kit MH001 (store page, Product Specification table). Every TDS/SDS value here is the PLA Basic document's value and describes the two filament rolls only; the page links none of these documents and says "For full specifications and compatibility details, please refer to the individual product pages linked below."

Hex entries are keyed by the colour names exactly as the PLA Basic hex-code table writes them. The product has no colour option (its only group is Item, value "Haunted House Bundle"), so source_value_id is empty and each entry names its bundle item instead.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (the registry has no *.printed / *.material split; raw-material properties are under material.* and thermal.*, printed-specimen results only under mechanical.*). The Z values are in each row's test_condition and are not stored as values.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa, Z 2060 ± 170 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (0.43 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), spool material and size, printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH), retraction length and speed, max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), and the chemical-resistance rows.

thermal.chamber_temp is not stored although the TDS (p.2) gives "Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C": the registry key is a single number used for a printer's chamber capability, and this is a recommended range for printing the filament.

material.net_weight is not stored and not listed as not_published: this page gives only "Quantity: 1 Roll" per colour and no roll weight. The TDS row "Net Filament Weight 1 kg" describes the standard PLA Basic spool, and PLA Basic is also sold in other roll sizes (the 250 g spools of the Color Trial Set), so it does not prove this bundle's roll weight. The store page's not_found row stands, and the searched documents join its checked sources.

material.spool_type is not stored and not listed as not_published: the page says neither "Refill" nor "Filament with spool" (only "Quantity: 1 Roll", and the feature bullet "2 themed PLA Basic filament spools", which is marketing prose), and the TDS spool rows describe the standard spool.

material.diameter_tolerance and safety.certifications are not stored and not listed as not_published: none of the documents read here states them, but the store's PLA Basic product page, which this bundle page names as the source of full specifications, states a tolerance and links certificate documents, so "not published by the manufacturer" would be untrue. That page and those certificates are outside this file's inputs and were not used as sources.
No spec of the LED Lamp Kit MH001 is stored: no document read here describes it; it has its own store product page (led-lamp-kit-001).

Not stored: the feature bullets ("Halloween-Ready Bundle", "Made for Haunted House Prints", "Create Atmospheric Scenes", "Printed Parts Not Included: … does not include the 3D printed parts shown in the main image") are product description, not specs; the "Standard Shipping Packaging" bullet is shipping policy and is not carried.
